content: Amcan iqeddsen

“D tina d tiweṣṣa d lfarayiḍ nni i ɣa teḥḍam maḥend ad tent teggem di temmurt nni i d ac iwca SIDI, AREBBI n řejdud nnec, ḥima ad tt teksid d řwart, marra ussan nni i ɣa teddarem kenniw x wudem n temmurt.
Ad tareddǧem qaɛ marra imucan mani tuɣa sexxaren řegnus i irebbiten nsen, marra imucan nni i ɣa teṭṭfem d řwart: x idurar yuɛřan, x tewririn u sadu kuř tacejjart tazizawt.

Ad tenḍarem iɛalṭaren nsen, ad tarẓem imayḍuten nsen iqeddsen u tirebbin nsen n cwarti ad tent tesscemḍem s tmessi uca ad thedmem řexyařat ineqcen n irebbiten nsen uca ad temḥam isem nsen zeg wemcan nni.
Minzi ammu war tɛebbdem i SIDI, AREBBI nwem am tteggen nitni,
maca ad tarzum x wemcan nni i ɣa yixḍar SIDI, AREBBI nwem, zi jar marra tiqebbař nwem, ḥima ad din igg Isem nnes, wah, ɣar Tzeddiɣt nnes i ɣa tarzum u din i ɣa tawḍem
uca dinni i ɣa tawyem tiɣarṣa nwem n wecmaḍ d tɣarṣa nwem d řeɛcur nwem d tewhibt nni issgeɛɛed ufus nwem d tewhibin nwem s řxaḍar d imenza n ifunasen d tfunasin nwem d imenza n wuǧi nwem,
uca dinni i ɣa teccem zzat i wudem n SIDI, AREBBI nwem, ad tfarḥem, kenniw d řaǧ n tudrin nwem, zi marra min igga ufus nwem u zi min di kenniw ibarek SIDI, AREBBI nnec.
War tteggem am marra min nᵉttegg neccin da ass-a: kuř aryaz ittegg min d as ittwařa nican di tiṭṭawin nnes.
Minzi aqa ɛad řexxu war tudifem ca ɣar arraḥet u ɣar řwart nni d awem iwca SIDI, AREBBI nnec.
Xmi ɣa teẓwam L’Urdun uca ad tzedɣem di temmurt nni d awem ɣa iwc SIDI, AREBBI nwem, d řwart, Netta ad awem iwc arraḥet zi marra řɛedyan nwem i d awem dd-innḍen uca ad tzedɣem di řaman.

Din i ɣa yiři wemcan nni i ɣa yixḍar SIDI, AREBBI nwem, ḥima ad issezdeɣ din Isem nnes uca dinni i ɣa tawyem marra min x cek umureɣ: tiɣarṣa n wecmaḍ nwem, tiɣarṣa nwem, řeɛcur nwem, tiwhibin n usgeɛɛed n ufus nwem d marra tiwhibin n lwaɛd nni i ɣa tweɛdem i SIDI.
Ad tfarḥem zzat i wudem n SIDI, AREBBI nwem, kenniw d iḥenjiren nwem d tḥenjirin nwem d isemɣan nwem d tiyya nwem d Ulawi nni izeddɣen daxeř i tewwura nwem, minzi war ɣares tasɣart niɣ řwart akidwem.
Ḥḍa war ssbexxara tiɣarṣa nnec n wecmaḍ di min ma amcan nni twařid,
maca waha deg wemcan nni i ɣa yixḍar SIDI deg icten zi tqebbař nnec, dinni waha i ɣa tessbexxared tiɣarṣa n wecmaḍ uca dinni i ɣa tegged marra min d ac umureɣ.
Tawṣeyyet x idammen u ḍidd i weɛbed n l’aṣnam n řegnus

S marra tzemmared ad tɣarṣed daxeř i tewwura nnec marra min immeẓri wuř nnec uca ad zzayes tecced ɛlaḥsab lbaraka nni d ac ɣa iwc SIDI, AREBBI nnec, daxeř i tewwura nnec. Amexmuj d umezdag zemmaren ad zzayes ccen, axmi ttetten zeg iɣayḍ n wezɣar u zeg udad.
Mɣir idammen war ten tᵉttetted. Ad ten tneɣřed x temmurt am waman.

War iɛeddeř ad tecced daxeř i tewwura nnec zi řeɛcur n irden d binu nnec n jdid d zzect nnec n ṭṭri uřa zeg imenza n ifunasen d tfunasin d wuǧi nnec niɣ zi tewhibin n wawař i tewcid niɣ zi tewhibin s řxaḍar niɣ zi tewhibt nni issgeɛɛed ufus nnec.

Minzi ad ten tecced zzat i wudem n SIDI, AREBBI nnec, deg wemcan nni ɣa yixḍar SIDI, AREBBI nnec, cek, mmic, yeǧic, ismeɣ nnec, tayya nnec d Ulawi nni izeddɣen daxeř i tewwura nnec uca ad tfarḥed zzat i wudem n SIDI, AREBBI nnec, di marra min ɣar ɣa isswiẓẓed ufus nnec.
Ḥḍa, war semmeḥ ɣar uzeǧif nnes Alawi di marra ussan nnec x temmurt nnec.”

“Xmi SIDI, AREBBI nnec, ad issiyru aymir n temmurt nnec, am mammec d ac inna, uca ad tinid: ‘Xseɣ ad cceɣ aysum’, minzi immeẓri řeɛmar nnec ad yecc aysum, xenni ad tecced aysum anect n marra min imeẓri řeɛmar nnec.

Mařa tuɣa cek tiggʷejed x wemcan nni i ɣa yixḍar SIDI, AREBBI nnec, ḥima ad din issemten Isem nnes, xenni tzemmared ad tɣarṣed zeg ifunasen d tfunasin nnec u zeg wuǧi nnec nni d ac iwca SIDI, am mammec cek umureɣ, uca ad zzayes tecced daxeř i tewwura nnec anect n marra min dayes immeẓri řeɛmar nnec.
Am mammec ittwacc iɣayḍ n wezɣar d udad, amenni i zzayes ɣa tecced. Amexmuj d umezdag zemmaren ad zzayes ccen.
Mɣir war ttᵉtt ɛemmarṣ zeg idammen, minzi idammen d řeɛmar. War ttᵉtt řeɛmar ak-d weysum.
War ten tᵉttᵉtted, maca ad ten tneɣřed x temmurt am waman.
War ten tᵉttᵉtted, ḥima ad tiřid cek mliḥ d iḥenjiren nnec awarni ac, xmi ɣa tegged min iseggden zzat i tiṭṭawin n SIDI.
Ad tawyed mɣir timesřayin nni ɣarek qeddsent d tɣarṣa n lwaɛd nnec uca ad kidsent dd-tased ɣar wemcan i ɣa yixḍar SIDI
uca ad tesswejded tiɣarṣa n wecmaḍ, aysum nnes d idammen nnes, x uɛalṭar n SIDI, AREBBI nnec, uca idammen n tɣarṣa ad ttwazeǧɛen x uɛalṭar n SIDI, AREBBI nnec, maca iɛeddeř ad tecced aysum.
Ḥḍa, u seř i marra awařen-a nni d ac umureɣ, ḥima ad tiřid mliḥ, cek d iḥenjiren nnec awarni ac i řebda, umi ɣa tegged min icnan d min iseggden di tiṭṭawin n SIDI, AREBBI nnec.”
“Xmi ɣa iteḥḥa SIDI, AREBBI nnec, řegnus mani ɣa traḥed ḥima ad ten teksid d řwart uca xenni cek ad ten teksid d řwart uca ad tzedɣed di temmurt nsen,

ḥḍa maḥend war tḍeffared awarni asen di řfex d ict, awarni ma ad ttwateḥḥan zzat i wudem nnec, uca ad tarzud x irebbiten nsen, ad tinid: ‘Am mammec sexxaren nitni i irebbiten nsen, ammu i ɣa ggeɣ uřa d necc.’

War ttegg amenni i SIDI, AREBBI nnec, minzi marra min iǧan d jjɛifect i SIDI d min icarreh Netta, aqa ggin t nitni i irebbiten nsen. Ɛad sscemḍen iḥenjiren nsen d yessitsen di tmessi i irebbiten nsen.”
